# TW Framework — Project Metadata (v0.9.28)
# Source: https://github.com/ffakraj-ui/twlang

## pyproject.toml

- Name: tw-framework
- Version: 0.9.28
- Requires-Python: >=3.9
- Authors: TW MRMK, TW MLKRAJ, TW ASLAM, TW BADAL, TW ROHIT, TW RISHU
- Dependencies: [] (core framework has no hard third-party dependencies)
- Optional dependencies:
  - dev = ["pytest>=7"]
  - image = ["Pillow>=10"]
- License: MIT

## Framework Structure

- Language: Custom DSL (.tw, .tss, .twm, .twp)
- Entry point: `tw` (CLI)
- Python modules: 96+ files in `tw_framework/`
- Tests: 1190 tests (30 test files)
- Render modes: static, server, edge, interactive, dynamic, csr
- Runtimes: Node.js, Edge V8, Python, WASM

## Key Modules

| Module | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| compiler.py | Main compilation pipeline |
| parser.py | AST parsing |
| app_router.py | File-based routing |
| server.py | HTTP server, SSR, streaming |
| cli.py | Command-line interface |
| security.py | CSP, CSRF, sanitization |
| reactivity.py | State management, VDOM |
| ppr.py | Partial prerendering |
| cache_tiers.py | Four-tier cache system |
| hooks.py | useOptimistic, useActionState, etc. |
| rsc_payload.py | RSC payload format |
| edge_middleware.py | Edge middleware |
| enhanced_actions.py | Server actions |
| infrastructure.py | Terraform IaC generator |
